lines.text: After eating, not after to eat!
Many learners say: After to eat, I wash the dishes.
Better: After eating, I wash the dishes.
After the word after, say eating.
Eating! After eating dinner, she sleeps.

data.wrong: After to eat, I wash the dishes.
data.right: After eating, I wash the dishes.
data.why: After the word after, say eating.
